scope: Independent source-semantic review; no execution, performance, C5 acceptance or QA verdict
sourceReview: Only an exact additional root name and its exact expanded-schema epoch select the already reviewed compiled strategy. The existing session epoch is unchanged and all other names, including definition fragments, retain original native root validation.

The complete canonical pass still precedes schema evaluation and the same fixed INVALID_CONTRACT 422 refusal remains. The implementation does not alter request bytes, size bounds, credential lookup, immutable budget checks or HTTP behavior.
The root shell retains all original root constraints and property names. Every present property, including explicit null, runs its original compiled native child schema without short circuit.
All nested conditional, composition, array and uniqueness assertions remain inside unchanged native child subtrees. The strategy does not split them recursively or reinterpret them.

Independent expansion confirms no remaining references, dynamic data pointers, dependency or unevaluated-property semantics that would require another top-level field as an instance root. Existing disabled defaults/listeners/customizer/discriminator guards remain unchanged.
The existing schema cache holds only compiled schema metadata. No runtime data, grant, authority proof or successful-validation result is cached.
Client, budget, publisher, the prior capture fix and original Lowerer request-byte and refusal-order checks are outside the two-file patch.
testReview: The existing Wire class remains seven test cases; two existing cases now cover both exact root contracts. The original recursive session corpus remains selected in full.
The replay corpus is bounded to twenty-seven root-field missing/null/array mutations, root shape and unknown-field cases, canonical refusals and five focused nested cases.

The original private schema(name) method compiles a fresh native oracle directly from actual resources; it never invokes the optimized strategy. Positive fixture acceptance and specialized property counts fourteen and nine prevent silent fallback or invalid-fixture vacuity.

Focused nested cases explicitly require native rejection for invalid secret-reference slot, unknown oneOf operation, duplicate unique source step and nested extra property, with native acceptance for the allowed secret-reference slot. Static schema audit independently confirms the secretRef-to-fill.value conditional and unique source-step constraint.

Unknown changed epochs require native baseline metadata and both accepted and rejected cross-property controls. The ValidationBasis fragment explicitly requires baseline metadata and valid/extra-field refusal controls.
All successful candidate representations are checked against the original canonical form; fixed refusal message/status and unchanged input representation are asserted.
minimumVerification: Root integrates only the two frozen files after base-hash confirmation and runs strict checks.

Root runs the affected Wire7, Lowerer36, Session43 and Ledger16 scope. Any Bridge37 reuse must retain the explicit disjoint-name/unchanged-strategy impact justification rather than claiming an unchanged whole GuidedContracts class hash.
After green defining checks, root runs one original unprofiled C5 with original deadlines, full ROOT plus APP TRACE and all thirty canary variants.
limits: The latest EXPIRED boundary proves that the first pre-send budget check failed after request validation, encoding, size and credential checks. It does not by itself allocate elapsed time exclusively to schema validation.
The source proves original whole-request diagnostic-root amplification. The extension reduces diagnostic roots while retaining all validation; achieved elapsed-time improvement remains unproved.
Artifact and validationBasis remain potentially large child roots. No further schema generalization or recursive split is authorized by this review.
No SDK acknowledgement, deadline success, publication plus two replay success, QA approval or lifecycle advancement is inferred.
